curl -sS -k -X POST "$API/CaseInfo/GetPersonalCase" -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" -H 'Origin: $ORIGIN' -H 'Language: zh-CN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"PagedInfo":{"pageIndex":1,"pageSize":20},"ProcStatusTypeList":[400], "TableType":50013,"ActiveName":"delivering","SelectedProcIdGroup":[]}' | python3 -c ' import json,sys for r in json.load(sys.stdin)["Data"]: print(r["CaseNo"], r["CaseProcUndertakerUserName"], r["CaseProcNameInfo"]["CaseProcName"]) '

curl -sS -k -X POST "$API/CaseMonitor/GetCaseMonitoringListByCase" -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" -H 'Origin: $ORIGIN' -H 'Language: zh-CN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{ "HasCaseInfoMoreParam": false, "CaseInfoMoreParam": {}, "StatType": 6, "CaseStatusCode": null, "ShowType": 2, "pageIndex": 1, "pageSize": 20 }'

curl -sS -k -X POST "$API/CaseInfo/GetPersonalCase" -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" -H 'Origin: $ORIGIN' -H 'Language: zh-CN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"PagedInfo":{"pageIndex":1,"pageSize":100},"ProcStatusTypeList":[400], "TableType":50013,"ActiveName":"delivering","SelectedProcIdGroup":[]}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("\n".join(r["CaseProcId"] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)["Data"]))' | while read -r cp; do curl -sS -k --get "$API/CaseMonitor/GetProcFlowRecord" -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" -H 'Language: zh-CN' --data-urlencode "caseProcId=$cp" | python3 -c ' import json,sys for x in json.load(sys.stdin).get("Data") or []: if x.get("IsCurrentFlowNode"): print(" 卡在 %s（%s）已 %.0f 小时" % (x["FlowUserName"], x["FlowStepName"], x.get("StayHours") or 0)) ' done
